csv_project_name: DB for Jet A Fuel Storage Tank Systems
csv_scope_of_work: Design -Build Services for two 30,000 Gallon Jet -A Fuel Tanks. The purpose of this Scope of Work (SOW) is to procure a Design -Build service for theconstruction of two new 30,000 -gallon Aboveground Storage Tanks (ASTs) to support JetA fueloperations. The project includes the acquisition of tanks and associated components, development of the foundation and anchoring design, and completion of allconstruction and commissioning activities needed to deliver a fully functional fuel storagesystem.

title: Design-Build for Jet A Fuel Storage Tank Systems
short_description: Design-build procurement for two new 30,000-gallon Jet A fuel storage tanks in Edinburg.
project_scope: Design-build services for construction of two new 30,000-gallon aboveground Jet A fuel storage tanks. Scope includes tank procurement and associated components, foundation and anchoring design, and all construction and commissioning activities required to deliver a fully functional fuel storage system.
services: Design-build services including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, underground tank design, mechanical engineering, construction/project management, foundation design, anchoring design, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
relevance_explanation:
- Fuel storage tank facility, not a bridge, building, sports venue, or architecturally demanding special structure in sbp's core target areas.
- Small construction budget indicates limited structural complexity.
- Includes some design scope (foundation and anchoring), but overall focus is industrial tank delivery and construction.
- Disciplines include civil and geotechnical engineering, yet the project is primarily a functional fuel infrastructure package.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents: total construction cost stated as $250.0K-$500.0K; midpoint converted directly to 375000 USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee stated in the tender documents. Available cost indication is a total construction cost range of 250000-500000 USD for a small design-build industrial tank project.
